## 47-Analyst Average Price Target for Apple Now Below Current Stock Price, One Week Pre-Earnings

Consensus PT below the current price going into earnings is a rare setup for Apple; it raises the bar for an earnings-driven re-rating and increases downside risk if results disappoint, while limiting near-term upside from analyst upgrades.

- The average price target across 47 sell-side analysts covering AAPL has fallen below the current stock price.
- The timing—one week ahead of Apple's earnings report—makes the setup particularly notable.
- Represents a bearish analyst positioning signal heading into the quarter.
- The specific figures are drawn directly from the headline; medium classifier confidence.
